custom_field: প্রতি প্রশ্নের মান ১ ও ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.৫০ কাটা যাবে।

English Grammar.question: ১) Because of his laziness, he failed the test. [Complex]
English Grammar.option1: For his to be lazy, he failed the test.
English Grammar.option2: As he was lazy, he failed the test.
English Grammar.option3: Since of his laziness, he failed the test.
English Grammar.option4: In oder to his laziness, he failed the test.
English Grammar.exp:
Simple: Because of his laziness, he failed the test.
Complex: As he was lazy, he failed the test.

• Because of যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Complex-এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Simple sentence এ because of থাকলে Complex sentence এর পরিবর্তে Since/ as ব্যবহৃত হয়।
- তারপর  Subject বসে + Verb বসে,
- এরপর Adjective /Noun + Comma বসে,
- সবশেষে অপর clause টি বসে।

More example: 
Simple: Because of my illness, I could not attend the meeting.
Complex: Since I was ill, I could not attend the meeting.

English Grammar.question: ২) What does the idiom "against the clock" mean?
English Grammar.exp:
• Against the clock
English Meaning: with or within a time constraint.
Bangla Meaning: দ্রুততার সাথে কাজ করা।

Ex. Sentence: I had to work against the clock to submit the project within the deadline.
Bangla Meaning: নির্দিষ্ট সময়ের মধ্যে প্রজেক্ট জমা দেওয়ার জন্য আমাকে অত্যন্ত দ্রুত কাজ করতে হয়েছে।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ৩) When it was storming, we stayed inside. [simple]
English Grammar.option1: While at the time of storming, we stayed inside.
English Grammar.option3: At the stormed, we stayed inside.
English Grammar.option4: At the time of storming, we stayed inside.
English Grammar.exp:
Complex: When it was storming, we stayed inside.
Simple: At the time of storming, we stayed inside.

• When দ্বারা সময় না বুঝিয়ে কোন কাজ চলা বোঝালে তখন,
- At the time of + when যুক্ত অংশের -ing যুক্ত ক্রিয়াটি বসে। 
- বাকি অংশ বসে। 

More examples:
Complex: When it was raining, Rahi woke up.
Simple: At the time of raining, Rahi woke up.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Grammar.question: ৪) Let her cook the food. [passive]
English Grammar.option1: Let the food to be cooked by her.
English Grammar.option2: The food to be cooked by her.
English Grammar.option3: Let the food be cooked by her.
English Grammar.option4: Let the food being cooked by her.
English Grammar.exp:
Active: Let her cook the food.
Passive: Let the food be cooked by her.

• Let যুক্ত Imperative sentence এর Active voice কে passive voice এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Let বসে।
- Object টির subject রূপে বসে।
- be বসে।
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে।
- by বসে।
- Active voice এর subject টির Object রূপে বসে।

• Structure: Let + Object টির subject বসে + be বসে + মূল verb এর past participle form বসে + by + subject টির Object রূপে বসে।

English Grammar.question: ৫) Choose the correct idiom: He sank back on his pillow and fell into a ______.
English Grammar.exp:
• Brown study
English Meaning: absorbed in one's thoughts and not paying attention to anything else.
Bangla Meaning: তীব্র নিমগ্নতা বা বিমূর্ততা / আনমনা ভাব। 

Ex. Sentence: I could see she was in a brown study.
Bangla Meaning: আমি দেখতে পাচ্ছিলাম সে খুব আনমনা হয়ে আছে।

Complete sentence: He sank back on his pillow and fell into a brown study.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ৬) What is the correct meaning of the word “Hotchpotch”?
English Grammar.exp:
• Hotchpotch
English Meaning: a confused mixture of different things.
Bangla Meaning: বিশৃঙ্খলা / জগাখিচুড়ি। 

Ex. Sentence: The palace seems to be a complete hotchpotch of architectural styles.
Bangla Meaning: এই প্রাসাদটি যেন স্থাপত্যশৈলীর এক জগাখিচুড়ি।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ৭) Rafi is one of the fastest runners in the school. [Comparative]
English Grammar.option1: Rafi is faster than other runners in the school.
English Grammar.option2: Rafi is faster than most other runner in the school.
English Grammar.option3: Rafi is faster than any other runners in the school.
English Grammar.option4: Rafi is faster than most other runners in the school.
English Grammar.exp:
Superlative: Rafi is one of the fastest runners in the school.
Comparative: Rafi is faster than most other runners in the school.

• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Comparative Degree তে রূপান্তর করার নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে প্রদত্ত Sentence- এর Subject ও Verb বসে,
- One of the উঠে যায়,
- Superlative Degree-এর Comparative form বসে,
- than most other বসে,
- প্রদত্ত Sentence- এর বাকী অংশ বসে।

Structure: Subject + Verb + Superlative Degree এর Comparative form + than most other + প্রদত্ত Sentence এর বাকী অংশ।

Superlative: He is one of the best players on the team.
Comparative: He is better than most other players on the team.

English Grammar.question: ৮) Having received the invitation, we attended the ceremony. [Compound]
English Grammar.option1: We had received the invitation and attended the ceremony.
English Grammar.option2: We had received the invitation and had attended the ceremony.
English Grammar.option3: We had received the invitation to attended the ceremony.
English Grammar.option4: We had received the invitation and to attended the ceremony.
English Grammar.exp:
Simple: Having received the invitation, we attended the ceremony.
Compound: We had received the invitation and attended the ceremony.

• Perfect Participle যুক্ত Simple Sentence কে Compound Sentence এ পরিবর্তনের নিয়ম:
- প্রথমে Subject বসে,
- Perfect Participle এর past Perfect form বসে,
- and বসে,
- বাকী অংশ বসে।

Simple: Having forgotten him, I went out.
Compound: I had forgotten him and went out.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Grammar.question: ৯) Jupiter is one of the largest planets in the solar system. [Positive]
English Grammar.option1: Very few planets in the solar system is as large as Jupiter.
English Grammar.option2: No other planet in the solar system are as large as Jupiter.
English Grammar.option3: Very few planets in the solar system are as large as Jupiter.
English Grammar.option4: No other planets in the solar system are as large as Jupiter.
English Grammar.exp:
Superlative: Jupiter is one of the largest planets in the solar system.
Positive: Very few planets in the solar system are as large as Jupiter.

• One of the যুক্ত Superlative Degree কে Positive Degree করার নিয়ম:
- Very few বসে।
- Superlative Adjective এর পর থেকে বাকি অংশ বসে।
- Verb এর Plural form বসবে।
- As/So + Superlative Adjective positive form + As
- প্রদত্ত Sentence এর Subject বসে।

Superlative: Iron is one of the most useful metals.
Positive: Very few metals are as useful as iron.

Superlative Degree Sentence: Shakespeare is one of the greatest writers.
Positive Degree Sentence: Very few writers are as great as Shakespeare.

English Grammar.question: ১০) She decided to paint the room. [change the voice]
English Grammar.option1: She decided that the room to be painted.
English Grammar.option2: She decided that the room should be painted.
English Grammar.option3: She decided that the room has to be painted.
English Grammar.option4: She decided the room should be painted.
English Grammar.exp:
Active: She decided to paint the room.
Passive: She decided that the room should be painted.

• Agree/ be anxious/ arrange/ determine/ be determined/ decide/ demand + infinitive + object যুক্ত Active voice কে passive করার নিয়ম:
- প্রদত্ত Active voice এর subject ও verb বসবে।
- that বসবে।
- infinitive এর পরের Object (direct object) বসবে।
- should be বসবে।
- infinitive এর পরের verb এর past participle বসবে।

Active: Proma decided to sell the house.
Passive: Proma decided that the house should be sold.

Active: They agreed to sign the contract.
Passive: They agreed that the contract should be signed.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Grammar.question: ১১) Having read the book, he wrote a review. [Complex]
English Grammar.option1: After he have read the book, he wrote a review.
English Grammar.option2: When he had read the book, he wrote a review.
English Grammar.option3: When he have read the book, he wrote a review.
English Grammar.option4: After he reading the book, he wrote a review.
English Grammar.exp:
Simple to Complex:
Simple: Having read the book, he wrote a review.
Complex: When he had read the book, he wrote a review.

Structure:
• Simple Sentence to Complex Sentence: (Having + Verb এর past participle form যুক্ত)
• Structure: Having এর পরিবর্তে When বসে + Subject + had + Verb এর past participle form + বাকী অংশ।

Simple: Having seen the movie, they discussed it.
Complex: When they had seen the movie, they discussed it.

- এ বাক্যে প্রথমেই Having এর পরিবর্তে When বসেছে।
- তারপর Subject - he বসেছে।
- এরপর had + Verb এর past participle form -read বসেছে।
- বাকী অংশ অপরিবর্তিত রয়েছে।

• এ জাতীয় আরোও একটি উদাহরণ - 
- Simple: Having told this, he went away.
- Complex: When he had told he went away.

- Simple: Having done this, he went away.
- Complex: When he had done this he went away.

Source: Advanced Learners Communicative English Grammar & Composition By Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Grammar.question: ১২) The children will be playing football in the park. [Change the voice]
English Grammar.option1: Football will be being played by the children in the park.
English Grammar.option2: Football will be play by the children in the park.
English Grammar.option3: Football will have been played by the children in the park.
English Grammar.option4: Football will been played by the children in the park.
English Grammar.exp:
Active: The children will be playing football in the park.
Passive: Football will be being played by the children in the park.

• Future continuous Tense যুক্ত active voice কে passive voice এ পরিণত করার নিয়ম -
- object টি subject রূপে বসে। 
- shall be being/ will be being বসে। 
- মূল verb এর past participle form বসে। 
- এরপর by বসে। 
- সবশেষে subject এর objective form বসে।

Active: The mentor will be advising us.
Passive: We shall be being advised by the mentor.

Active: The host will be welcoming the guests.
Passive: The guests will be being welcomed by the host.

Source: Advanced Learner's by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Grammar.question: ১৩) It is certain that the event will be held next week. [simple]
English Grammar.option1: The event will be held next week it is certain.
English Grammar.option2: Certainly, the event will be held next week.
English Grammar.option3: Certainly that the event will held next week.
English Grammar.option4: The event will be held next week to be certain.
English Grammar.exp:
• Complex sentence এ it is certain, it is surely, it is sudden থাকলে Simple sentence এ
- it is certain এর পরিবর্তে certainly হবে + এর পরের relative pronoun টি বাদ যাবে + বাকি sentence টি বসবে।

Complex: It is certain that the event will be held next week.
Simple: Certainly, the event will be held next week.

• অন্য দিকে, 
- it is certain এর পরিবর্তে certainly হবে,
- it is sudden এর পরিবর্তে suddenly হবে,
- it is surely এর পরিবর্তে surelyহবে।

যেমন:
Complex: It is certain that he will come here.
Simple: Certainly, he will come here.

Complex: It was sudden that he lost his mobile.
Simple: Suddenly, he lost his mobile.

Complex: It is sure that Riva has done it.
Simple: Surely, Riva has done it.

Source: Advance Learner's English Grammar and Composition by Chowdhury & Hossain.

English Grammar.question: ১৪) Synonym of 'Mendacious' -
English Grammar.exp:
• Mendacious (adjective)
English Meaning: Not telling the truth; lying.
Bangla Meaning: (আনুষ্ঠানিক) মিথ্যা; মিথ্যাবাদী: mendacious reports.

Synonyms: Untruthful (মিথ্যাবাদী), Dishonest (অসাধু), Deceitful (প্রতারণাপূর্ণ), Lying (মিথ্যা), Fraudulent (ধোঁকাবাজি)।
Antonyms: Truthful (সত্যনিষ্ঠ), Honest (সৎ), Veracious (সত্যনিষ্ঠ), Frank (নির্ভীক), Sincere (একনিষ্ঠ)। 

Example Sentence: 
1. That promise has been revealed as mendacious nonsense.
2. The newspaper story was mendacious and hurtful.

Options,
- Abstruse (নিগূঢ়), 
- Partition (বিভাজন)।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ১৫) Pick the correct spelling:
English Grammar.exp:
• Independent:
English meaning: not influenced or controlled in any way by other people, events, or things.
Bangla meaning: স্বাধীন; স্বনির্ভর। 

Example:
- An independent enquiry will determine whether the case should move forward.
- The audit will be done by an independent organization.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

English Grammar.question: ১৬) Choose the correct spelling:
English Grammar.exp:
• Bureaucracy: 
English Meaning: A system for controlling or managing a country, company, or organization that is operated by a large number of officials employed to follow rules carefully. 
Bangla Meaning: আমলাতন্ত্র; আমলাদের পরিচালিত প্রশাসনিক ব্যবস্থা। 

Example Sentence
- I had to deal with the university's bureaucracy when I was applying for financial aid.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

English Grammar.question: ১৭) 'Rank and file' means -
English Grammar.option1: The ordinary members of an organization
English Grammar.option2: The rules and regulations of an office
English Grammar.exp:
• Rank and file
English Meaning: the ordinary members of an organization as opposed to its leaders.
Bangla Meaning: সাধারণ স্তরের.

Ex. Sentence: He is a rank-and-file soldier.
Bangla Meaning: সে একজন সাধারণ সৈন্য।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ১৮) She answered <u>in a polite manner</u>.- Here 'in a polite manner' is -
English Grammar.exp:
• She answered in a polite manner.- Here the underlined part is an - Adverbial Phrase.

• Adverbial Phrase:
- যে phrase বাক্যে ব্যবহৃত হয়ে adverb এর মত কাজ করে তাকে Adverbial Phrase বলে ৷
- সাধারণত বাক্যকে কখন ( when), কোথায় ( where), কেন( why) ও কিভাবে (how) দ্বারা প্রশ্ন করলে উত্তর হিসেবে যে phrase পাওয়া যায় সেটি Advrbial phrase.

• She answered in a polite manner.
- এই বাক্যে কিভাবে (how) দ্বারা প্রশ্ন করলে উত্তর পাওয়া যাবে।
- যেমন: 'কিভাবে answer করেছিল' এর উত্তর পাওয়া যায় 'in a polite manner'.
- তাই এটি Adverbial Phrase.

Source: A Passage to the English Language by SM Zakir Hussain.

English Grammar.question: ১৯) He kept the books on <u>the wooden shelf</u>. Here, 'the wooden shelf' is
English Grammar.exp:
He kept the books on the wooden shelf. Here, 'the wooden shelf' is an example of - Noun phrase.
- Preposition'on' এর object হিসাবে এখানে the wooden shelf- noun phrase হয়েছে।

• Noun phrase:
- A noun phrase consists of a pronoun or noun and any associated modifiers, including adjectives, adjective phrases, adjective clauses and other nouns in the possessive case.
- অধিকাংশ সময়ই, Noun phrase মূলত: একটি Noun বা Pronoun এর কাজ করে।
- এছাড়া, অর্থ এবং বাক্যে অবস্থান অনুযায়ী Noun phrase বিভিন্ন ভূমিকা পালন করে ।

যেমন:
- Subject হিসেবে।
- Object of a verb হিসেবে।
- Object of a preposition হিসেবে।
- Subject complement হিসেবে।
- Object complement হিসেবে।

English Grammar.question: ২০) The word 'Complaisant' means -
English Grammar.option1: Difficult to do or needing a lot of effort
English Grammar.option3: Not happening or appearing in a pattern
English Grammar.exp:
• Complaisant (adjective)
English Meaning: Willing to satisfy others by being polite and fitting in with their plans.
Bangla Meaning: অন্যকে খুশি করতে আগ্রহী।

Example Sentence: 
1. Noah's eyes were slightly jealous, but he was so complaisant that I figured he'd get over it in a day.
2. Barbara mentions that a lockout calendar would remind our members not to be complaisant.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ২১) We visited <u>the ancient temple</u>. Here 'the ancient temple' is an example of -
English Grammar.exp:
• We visited the ancient temple. The underlined part is an example of - Noun phrase.
- কারণ Article + Adjective + Noun = Noun Phrase.
- প্রশ্ন প্রদত্ত বাক্যে the(article) + ancient (adjective) + temple (noun), তাই এটি noun phrase হবে।

• Noun phrase:
- A noun phrase consists of a pronoun or noun and any associated modifiers, including adjectives, adjective phrases, adjective clauses and other nouns in the possessive case.
- অধিকাংশ সময়ই, Noun phrase মূলত: একটি Noun বা Pronoun এর কাজ করে।
- এছাড়া, অর্থ এবং বাক্যে অবস্থান অনুযায়ী Noun phrase বিভিন্ন ভূমিকা পালন করে ।

যেমন:
- Subject হিসেবে।
- Object of a verb হিসেবে।
- Object of a preposition হিসেবে।
- Subject complement হিসেবে।

English Grammar.question: ২২) The word 'Effrontery' means -
English Grammar.option2: Unusual and strange in a way that might be funny
English Grammar.option3: Lasting for only a short time
English Grammar.exp:
Effrontery [noun] [Uncountable noun]
English Meaning: Insolent or impertinent behavior.
Bangla Meaning: ঔদ্ধত্য; নির্লজ্জ সাহস।

Example Sentence: 
1. He then committed several acts of brazen effrontery.
2. The little squirt had the effrontery to deny eating any cookies, even with the crumbs still on his lips.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ২৩) 'Fledgling' means -
English Grammar.option4: To make a bad or unpleasant situation better
English Grammar.exp:
• Fledgling (adjective)
English Meaning: New and not experienced.
Bangla Meaning: নতুন এবং অনভিজ্ঞ। 

Example Sentence:
1. You are the leader of the opposition in this emerging, fledgling democracy.
2. At hockey, he's still a fledgling and needs to work on his basic skating skills.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ২৪) The idiom 'Achilles heel' means –
English Grammar.option2: A symbol of strength and power
English Grammar.exp:
Achilles heel:
English Meaning: a weakness or vulnerable point/ a weak point.
Bangla Meaning: দুর্বল বা ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ স্থান।

Ex. Sentence: Maths has always been my Achilles heel.
বাক্যের অর্থ: গণিত সর্বদাই আমার বড় দুর্বলতা ছিল।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture ও Oxford Dictionary.

English Grammar.question: ২৫) Choose the correct spelling.
English Grammar.exp:
Millennium (noun):
English Meaning: a period of 1,000 years, especially as calculated before or after the birth of Christ
Bangla Meaning: 
১. সহস্রাব্দ; বর্ষসহস্রক।
২. (লাক্ষণিক) সবার জন্য অপরিমিত সুখসমৃদ্ধিপূর্ণ ভাবীকল; অনাগত স্বর্ণযুগ।

Example:
- The corpse had lain preserved in the soil for almost two millennia.

English Grammar.question: ২৬) Which of the following is the synonym of 'Altitude'?
English Grammar.exp:
• Altitude: 
- English meaning: the height above sea level, great height.
- Bengali meaning: সমুদ্রপৃষ্ঠ থেকে উচ্চতা।

• অপশনে উল্লিখিত শব্দগুলোর মধ্যে -
• Height:
- উচ্চতা; উন্নতি; উত্তুঙ্গতা। 

• Width:
- প্রশস্ততা। 

• Length:
- দৈর্ঘ্য। 

• Depth:
- গভীরতা; ঘনতা। 

• সুতরাং, অপশন বিবেচনা করে বুঝা যাচ্ছে, The synonym of 'altitude' is - Height.

English Grammar.question: ২৭) Antonym of 'Empirical' -
English Grammar.exp:
• Empirical (adjective)
English Meaning: Based on what is experienced or seen rather than on theory.
Bangla Meaning: বাস্তব অভিজ্ঞতা, যিনি তত্ত্বের চেয়ে পর্যবেক্ষণ ও পরীক্ষা-নিরীক্ষার উপর নির্ভরশীল, প্রায়োগিক।

Synonyms: Factual (সত্য ঘটনাসম্পর্কিত), Practical (প্রায়োগিক), Experimental (পরীক্ষামূলক), Observed (নিরীক্ষিত), Seen (দেখা)।
Antonyms: Theoretical (তত্ত্বীয়), Conjectural (অনুমানমূলক), Hypothetical (কাল্পনিক), Unproven (অপ্রমানিত), Visionary (দূরদর্শী)।  

Example Sentence: 
1. I think it is too much a matter of perception, rather than there being empirical evidence.
2. Guidelines for raising children that are based on empirical evidence.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ২৮) The idiom 'The status quo' refers -
English Grammar.option3: A situation in which something which was intended to have a particular result
English Grammar.exp:
• The status quo
English Meaning: the present situation / the existing state of affairs.
Bangla Meaning: বর্তমান অবস্থা। 

Ex. Sentence: Certain people always want to maintain the status quo.
Bangla Meaning: কিছু মানুষ সবসময়ই তার বর্তমান অবস্থা বলবৎ রাখতে চায়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ২৯) What is "Postscript" in letter?
English Grammar.option1: The main message of a letter
English Grammar.option2: The address section of a letter
English Grammar.option3: A formal greeting at the beginning of a letter
English Grammar.option4: An additional remark at the end of a letter
English Grammar.exp:
• Postscript (n) (সংক্ষেপে PS): 
- An additional remark at the end of a letter, after the signature and introduced by ‘PS’.
- an extra piece of information about an event that is added after it has happened.
- বাংলা অর্থ - পুনশ্চ।
- It comes from the Latin - postscriptum, which literally means “written after.”
- An extra message added at the end of a letter after it is signed.
- চিঠিতে স্বাক্ষরের পরে যুক্ত বাক্যাবলী; পুনশ্চ; অতিরিক্ত বা সর্বশেষ তথ্য।

Source:
1. Oxford Learner's Dictionary.
2. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

English Grammar.question: ৩০) How many parts are there in a paragraph?
English Grammar.exp:
• Paragraph হলো এমন একটি ক্ষুদ্র রচনা যার মধ্যে একটি মাত্র, idea বা theme থাকে।

• তাছাড়া Paragraph এ সাধারণত তিনটি অংশ থাকে।
• Topic Sentence: 
- একটি Paragraph এর প্রধান idea বা theme যে বাক্যের দ্বারা প্রকাশিত হয় তাকে topic sentence বলে।
- Topic Sentence সাধারণত কোনো Paragraph এর শুরুতে লেখা হয়। 
- Topic Sentence এ অবশ্যই একটি Controlling Idea থাকবে যা Paragraph এর বাকি অংশ Control করে।

• Body:
- প্রথম sentence- এর পর থেকে শেষ sentence এর আগ পর্যন্ত পুরো অংশটাকে parragraph এর body বলা যায়।
- এতে এমন সব বাক্যসমষ্টি থাকে যা paragraph এর মূল idea বা theme কে উপস্থাপিত করে।

• Terminator:
- এটাকে paragraph এর সমাপ্তি, উপসংহার বলে। এটি দিয়ে Paragraph শেষ হয়।
- অর্থাৎ একটি সার্থক সমাপ্তিসূচক sentence কে বলা হয় Terminator.

• অন্যদিকে,
• Linkers are often used in a paragraph.
- Linker Words or Word Connectors are used to link large groups of words: phrases and sentences.

Source: A Passage to the English Language, S.M. Zakir Hussain.

English Grammar.question: ৩১) Antonym of 'Implacable' -
English Grammar.exp:
• Implacable (adjective)
English Meaning: Used to describe (someone who has) strong opinions or feelings that are impossible to change.
Bangla Meaning: (আনুষ্ঠানিক) শান্ত করা যায় না এমন; অপ্রশম্য; নিষ্করুণ; কৃপাহীন: an implacable enemy; implacable hatred/love.

Synonyms: Unappeasable (শান্ত, তুষ্ট বা প্রশমিত করার অসাধ্য), Inexorable (নির্মম), Adamant (অনড়), Obdurate (অবাধ্য), Obstinate (অনড়)।
Antonyms: Acquiescent (প্রশ্রয়প্রবণ), Compliant (অন্যের ইচ্ছাপূরণে সম্মত), Relenting (কোমল হত্তয়া), Amenable (নমনীয়), Pliant (প্রত্যুৎপন্ন)।

Example Sentence: 
1. They were confronted by an apparently implacable bureaucracy.
2. He has an implacable hatred for his political opponents.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ৩২) <u>Running a marathon</u> can be painful but exhilarating. Here 'Running a marathon' is an example of -
English Grammar.exp:
Running a marathon can be painful but exhilarating. The underlined part is an example of - Gerundial Phrase.

• Running a marathon can be painful but exhilarating.
- এই বাক্যে "Running a marathon" অংশটি Gerundial Phrase.
- "Running" হলো একটি gerund (verb+ing), যা এখানে noun হিসেবে কাজ করছে।
- "a marathon" হলো Gerundial Phrase এর extension, যা "Running" এর সাথে যুক্ত হয়ে বাকি তথ্য প্রদান করছে।
- অর্থাৎ, "Running a marathon" is a gerundial phrase, where "Running" is a gerund acting as the subject of the sentence.

• Gerundial Phrase:
- Verb+ing + Extension যদি Noun (Subject/ Object) এর কাজ করে তবে তাকে Gerundial Phrase বলে।
- Verb+ing – noun এর কাজ করলে সেটা Gerund হয়।
- আর Gerund এর সাথে Object বা Modifier থাকলে Gerundial Phrase হয়।

Gerundial Phrase এর আরো কিছু উদহারণ:
- Walking in the morning is good for health.
- Helping the poor is a great virtue.
- Stop telling lies.
- Cycling on the hill tracks is not easy.

English Grammar.question: ৩৩) What does the term "Round-robin" refer to?
English Grammar.option2: A one-on-one debate between two individuals
English Grammar.option3: A farewell message given at the end of an event
English Grammar.option4: A letter of demands or complaints signed by many people, often in a circular fashion
English Grammar.exp:
• Round-robin (Noun)
English Meaning: A letter, usually of demands or complaints, that is signed by many people; a written petition, memorial, or protest to which the signatures are affixed in a circle so as not to indicate who signed first
Bangla Meaning: সাধারণত দাবি বা অভিযোগে সম্বলিত একটি চিঠি, যা অনেক লোক স্বাক্ষর করে বা যে দরখাস্তে বৃত্তাকারে স্বাক্ষর থাকে যার ফলে বোঝা না-যায় কার পরে কে স্বাক্ষর করছে।

Source:
1. Cambridge Dictionary.
2. Merriam-Webster Dictionary.
3. Accessible Dictionary by Bangla Academy.

English Grammar.question: ৩৪) They played the match, <u>in spite of</u> the heavy rain. Here 'in spite of' is an example of -
English Grammar.exp:
They played the match, in spite of the heavy rain. The underlined part is an example of - Phrase preposition.

• Phrase preposition:
- কয়েকটি word গুচ্ছগতভাবে Preposition এর কাজ করে।
- Phrase preposition এর শুরুতে এবং শেষে preposition থাকে।
- যেমন - in front of, because of, according to, in spite of ইত্যাদি।

• যেহেতু, in spite of এর শুরুতে  এবং শেষে preposition আছে তাই এটি phrase preposition.

English Grammar.question: ৩৫) Letters are mainly ______ types.
English Grammar.exp:
• Letter দুই প্রকার।
যথা -
i) Informal Letter : যা ব্যক্তিগতভাবে আত্মীয়স্বজন বা বন্ধুবান্ধবের কাছে পাঠানো হয়।
ii) Formal Letter: Official বা Business সংক্রান্ত চিঠিপত্র. যেমন - Application, Memorandum ইত্যাদি।
 
• The types of formal letters are mentioned below.
- Letter of Enquiry.
- Order Letter.
- Letter of Complaint.
- Reply to a Letter of Complaint.
- Promotion Letter.
- Sales Letters.
- Recovery Letters

English Grammar.question: ৩৬) What does the phrase "Moot point" mean?
English Grammar.option1: A decision that has been finalized
English Grammar.option3: A question with a clear and obvious answer
English Grammar.option4: A subject that people cannot agree about
English Grammar.exp:
• Moot point
English Meaning: a subject that people cannot agree about.
Bangla Meaning: অমীমাংসিত বিষয়

Ex. Sentence: Who is the best footballer is a moot point.
Bangla Meaning: কে সবচেয়ে সেরা ফুটবলার এটা একটা অমীমাংসিত বিষয়।

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ৩৭) Synonym of 'Discerning' -
English Grammar.exp:
• Discerning (adjective)
English Meaning: Able to make or usually making careful judgments about the quality of similar things.
Bangla Meaning: নির্ণয় করতে বা উপলব্ধি করতে সক্ষম; প্রাজ্ঞ।

Synonyms: Judicious (সুবিবেচনাপূর্ণ; বিচক্ষণ), Insightful (অন্তর্দৃষ্টিপূর্ণ), Percipient (উপলব্ধিক্ষমতাসম্পন্ন), Sagacious (বিচক্ষণ), Wise (জ্ঞানী)।
Antonyms: Undiscerning (নির্ণয় করতে সক্ষম নয়), Indiscriminate (বাছবিচারহীন; নির্বিশেষ), Neglectful (উপেক্ষাপূর্ণ), Unaware (অপরিজ্ঞাত), Nearsighted (অদূরদর্শী)। 

Example Sentence:
1. We have a very good customer base now, but it's also a very discerning customer base, he says.
2. She has a discerning eye for good art.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.

English Grammar.question: ৩৮) Identify the correctly spelled word:
English Grammar.exp:
• Hierarchy:
English meaning: a system in which people or things are arranged according to their importance.
Bangla meaning: যে সংগঠন নিম্নতম থেকে উচ্চতম পর্যায় পর্যন্ত ক্রমবিভক্ত কর্তৃত্বের ভিত্তিতে সংগঠিত; ক্রমাধিকারতন্ত্র; আধিপত্য-পরম্পরা; প্রাধান্যপরম্পরা। 

Example: 
- He rose quickly through the political hierarchy to become party leader.

Source: Cambridge Dictionary.

English Grammar.question: ৩৯) Never compromise your values. [change the voice]
English Grammar.option1: Let never your values be compromised.
English Grammar.option2: Let not your value be compromised.
English Grammar.exp:
Active: Never compromise your values.
Passive: Let never your values be compromised.

• Never যুক্ত Imperative Sentence কে Passive করার structure: 
- প্রথমে Let Never বসে
- Object টি Subject রূপে বসে
- be বসে 
- মূল verb এর  Past participle হয়।

তাই নিয়মানুযায়ী,
Active: Never tell a lie.
Passive: Let never a lie be told.

English Grammar.question: ৪০) The word 'Contrite' means -
English Grammar.option2: Feeling or expressing remorse or guilt
English Grammar.exp:
• Contrite (adjective)
English Meaning: Feeling regret and guilt for something bad that you have done.
Bangla Meaning: কৃতকর্মের জন্য গভীরভাবে অনুতপ্ত; পাপবোধ দ্বারা পীড়িত।

Example Sentence: 
- I am immensely contrite, and I am sorry for the damage that I've done.

Source: Live MCQ Lecture.
